title: Employer UI Tax Accounts — Estimate Share Schedule for Penalty Relief
content:
On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the full penalty paid in a penalty relief request is multiplied by an estimate share. The estimate share follows the estimated assessments booked on the account within the estimate lookback months, 12.

| Estimated assessments booked within 12 months | Estimate share |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.7 |
| Exactly one | 0.85 |
| None | 1 |

The 12 months are counted in whole months back from the day of the request, by the entry dates of the estimated assessments in the account's balance history. Only contribution assessments that rest on an estimate count; assessments from filed or amended reports do not.

## Schedule notes (hypothetical penalty paid of USD 200.00)

- Estimated assessments booked 3 and 9 months before the request: two, share 0.7; the penalty paid multiplied by the share is USD 140.00.
- One estimated assessment booked 9 months before and another 14 months before: one within 12 months, share 0.85, USD 170.00.
- An estimated assessment booked 13 months before and none since: none within 12 months, share 1, USD 200.00.
